# Thirza Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Over fifty years old  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley, St. Brendan’s Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029), [v1 c6 P36](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0036)</sub>

## Appearance

Thirza is a tall, slender woman with sharp angles rather than curves. She has dark hair with graying strands bound tightly at the back in a firm bun, pierced combatively by two wire hairpins. Her mouth shows a redeeming quality that hints at a humorous disposition.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)_

## Personality

Thirza gives the impression of having a limited background and an unyielding sense of morality. She is intensely practical, orderly, and agonizingly neat, holding a strong disdain for daydreaming, loquacity, and romance. Though she appears sharp and abrupt, she possesses an underlying sense of humor, deep integrity, and a hidden capacity for fierce, devoted affection.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c4 P10](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0010), [v1 c5 P5](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0005), [v1 c23 P24](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0024), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003)_

## Traits

- Extremely neat and orderly  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009)</sub>
- Strict and moral  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c7 P6](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0006)</sub>
- Practical and unromantic  <sub>[v1 c3 P20](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0020), [v1 c5 P5](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0005), [v1 c8 P13](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0013)</sub>
- Deeply loving beneath a stern exterior  <sub>[v1 c23 P24](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0024), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003)</sub>

## Abilities

- Skilled homemaker and cook  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c16 P27](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0027), [v1 c21 P12](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0012)</sub>
- Farming and dairy work  <sub>[v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029), [v1 c6 P36](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0036)</sub>
- Making homemade currant wine  <sub>[v1 c16 P46](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0046)</sub>

## Goals

- To raise Nell and the Farrow twins into proper, useful, and dutiful individuals  <sub>[v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v1 c7 P29](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0029), [v2 c7 P31](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0031)</sub>
- To maintain Grey Shutters and keep her family together  <sub>[v1 c38 P23](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0023), [v1 c38 P28](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0028)</sub>

## History

Thirza resides at Grey Shutters in Brierley with her quiet brother, Obed. Expecting an orphan boy to help on the farm, she is shocked when Obed arrives with a red-haired orphan girl, Nell Harcourt. Although she initially intends to send Nell back, compassion leads Thirza to keep her. She takes on the challenge of raising the imaginative child, teaching her housework, manners, and religious duties. When Obed dies suddenly after losing their savings in a bank failure, Thirza is devastated. Facing failing eyesight and threat of blindness, she considers selling Grey Shutters, but Nell gives up her college scholarship to stay home and teach, enabling them to keep the farm. To help with expenses and companionship, Thirza takes in her orphan third-cousins, the twins Robin and Lucy Farrow, as well as her widowed friend Agatha Sowerby. Over the years, Thirza grows deeply attached to Nell, eventually realizing how completely the girl has transformed her life.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c3 P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c7 P29](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0029), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c38 P4](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0004), [v1 c38 P12](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0012), [v1 c38 P20](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0020), [v2 c7 P25](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0025), [v2 c26 P21](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0021)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up in Brierley in a house built far back from the main road by her shy father  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Overheard an aunt call her a 'dark, homely little thing' in her youth  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- Had a youth romance with John Carrow that ended due to an unpardoned argument  <sub>[v1 c37 P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040)</sub>

## Quotes

> Nell is a truly excellent, simple, and practical name. There is no reason for you to feel embarrassed by it.  <sub>[v1 c3 P20](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0020)</sub>

> Agatha, it was wrong of you to mock her appearance.  <sub>[v1 c9 P26](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0026)</sub>

> I’m not feeling discouraged, when my mind is made up to do something, it remains made up.  <sub>[v1 c9 P12](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0012)</sub>

> I would rather watch you obey my instructions precisely.  <sub>[v1 c13 P12](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0012)</sub>

> My love for you is as deep as though you were my very own child, and from the moment you arrived at Grey Shutters, you have brought me nothing but happiness and solace.  <sub>[v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020)</sub>
